title.narrative: Strengthening the diary sector in Ninewa, Iraq

description.narrative: Objective: Strengthening the dairy sector by promoting good practices in dairy farming and strengthening farmer association in Ninewa, Iraq.. As part of OXFAM partnership approach, a joint assessment of needs of the association will be done. There is two elements of the assessment identify organisational capacity strengthening needs and identify and providing their equipment and tools needs. So, the association is able to provide local farmers with regular guidance, services and support through the organization and delivery of trainings and awareness workshops. The association will also lead to organize networking events with all the value chain actors to create linkages with traders from the private sector. A training will be delivered (3 -5 days) by the relevant experts in the topics of networking, linkages legal and financial systems of associations and access to finance modalities and planning (saving groups and revolving funds). This capacity building trainings will be strengthening the association to better organize the sector of dairy farming and become able to increase their collective bargaining power and improve their linkages with the dairy processors and resources. In coordination with Oxfam the farmer's association for dairy producers, will select 150 farmers among the milk producers in AlHamdaniyah to receive a 3 day training on the topics of dairy farming best practices, feed management, and disease prevention for increased milk production. Participants will also receive a practical manual that includes information relevant to feed formulations, vaccination calendars, prevention techniques and early detection for diseases and diagnosis. The training will also introduce the farmers to the association and present its role and plan of action for the dairy sector.
